naturalLanguageQuery: show me controls that don't have any FAQs in the same category
generatedSQL:
SELECT DISTINCT "short", "long"
FROM "allTrustControls" AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM "allTrustFaqs" AS f
  WHERE f."category" = c."category"
    AND f."id" IN (c."id")
);
explanation: || , The SQL query is well-structured and efficient. It uses a subquery with NOT EXISTS to filter out rows from 'allTrustControls' where there are corresponding rows in 'allTrustFaqs' with the same category and id.
